hypit-ai/hypit.caption:
This GitHub repo hit 23K stars, and it clones viral videos with AI agents. This reel was made with it.

It's called Hypit. Point your coding agent at a reel that's already working, and it rebuilds the whole format, not just the script.

- Captions, B-roll and effects, all timed to the words
